_doc: Curated public fields per brew, keyed by the record id without the device prefix. See README for the field contract.

37d993bf6721a1e7-1.note: A little better than the earlier cups that day.

61b47a54ad2e75b1-2.method: Stirred throughout; the final drawdown was slow.

9074c78880db56d5-1.note: Flat and muted. Faint sourness as it cools, with peanut, roasted-barley grain and a slightly green edge.

2c712288877fc179-1.method: 30 g dose with 500 g water. Last drops measured 0.69% TDS.

78bd9331ae9cff7b-1.method: Fines sieved into a tea bag and steeped with the grounds; the bag came out before the last 100 ml was poured with the valve open. The bed clogged.

e726ba44eff0047b-1.method: Two-stage: closed-valve steep, then the last 100 ml poured with the valve open. Leftover liquid 1.15% TDS.

manual-20261104-limu1.note: Sharp sourness and slight bitterness with a nutty aftertaste; the finish stays sour and mouth-drying.
manual-20261104-limu1.method: Switch base with a V60 Neo cone. Two-stage with stirring: 100 g steeped for 1 min and drained, then the valve closed and the rest of the water added.

b1318dbb16c8e5d2-1.note: Less sharp sourness than the two-stage cup; bitterness stays in the finish.
b1318dbb16c8e5d2-1.method: All water at once to 1:16, valve opened at 2:00, done at 3:00. Last drops 1.58% TDS.

56ec1011be05c6cb-1.note: The sharp sourness turned into rounder acidity, little green character, less mouth-drying; but one-dimensional, like lemon water.
56ec1011be05c6cb-1.method: Same as the previous cup at 1:17, with stirring. Leftover liquid 1.41% TDS.

e1dda67afbe4bff8-1.method: Evaluation recipe: 1:16 with stirring, 4:00 total. Last drops 1.59% TDS.

3ff21d79955ff5eb-1.note: Bright acidity and clear sweetness; a clean cup with no off-flavors.
3ff21d79955ff5eb-1.method: Stirred; fines clogged the filter and it dripped for about 8 minutes.

31da79748aa9f79b-1.note: A little thin at this extraction. Creamy sweetness, smoky, with a touch of chocolate and toffee.

10931dfe1b0029ed-1.note: The roasted-barley note from cupping is gone; short aftertaste, and the orange from the bag notes is missing.

d9630173b6825abd-1.note: Slightly bitter with a mouth-drying finish.
d9630173b6825abd-1.method: Stirred throughout; the drain slowed and the brew ran to 5:00. A/B pair with the next cup.

8f000ddc24f1e1ac-1.note: Much better than the stirred cup: no noticeable bitterness or mouth-drying.
8f000ddc24f1e1ac-1.method: No stirring; done at 3:00. A/B pair with the previous cup.

manual-20261106-darkrider1.method: Deliberately strong ratio at low extraction, for fun. 1 g dried osmanthus added with the grounds (it raises the TDS reading); Shuke filter paper.

7f437419c016a54d-1.note: A standout cup: pronounced sweetness, soft and gentle, light acidity, no mouth-drying, clean.

97de9423a8d23068-1.note: Preferred over the 1:16 cup brewed right after it.
97de9423a8d23068-1.method: Stirred; valve opened at 1:40 and fully drained. Ratio-only pair with the next cup.

81d23cb416984384-1.note: Less preferred than the 1:17 cup brewed just before it.
81d23cb416984384-1.method: Stirred; valve opened at 1:40 and fully drained. Only the ratio changed.

98c6f8a2ea7a7f99-1.note: No sharp sourness; orange and jasmine, but the aroma is a little faint.
98c6f8a2ea7a7f99-1.method: 1:15 with stirring; valve opened at 1:30 and fully drained.

809efec0d2740e8c-1.note: Hot: sour and mouth-drying with a sweet aftertaste. Below about 52 °C the drying eases into lemon-like acidity with sweetness; strawberry, raspberry, stone fruit.

manual-20261108-seycolombia1.method: 1:14, one 5 s stir at about 1:00, valve opened at 1:30, drained by 2:30.

manual-20261108-esmeralda2.method: Same recipe as the El Tambo cup before it: 1:14, one short stir, valve opened at 1:30.

2a439f3ec31f2554-1.method: Stirred continuously from the end of the pour until the valve opened; fully drained by 3:00.

686ee436e395fb6c-1.note: Strongly sour and mouth-drying; no burnt bitterness and no nutty notes.

manual-20261109-darkrider.method: Stirred before the valve opened at 2:00; no stirring after.
manual-20261109-darkrider.correction: The watch beverage weight was invalid (304.5 g) and is left blank.

manual-20261109-gotiti-b4-2.method: Drained until no liquid showed above the bed, then closed the valve.
manual-20261109-gotiti-b4-2.correction: The watch timer started 2:20 early; time corrected from 5:45 to 3:25.

07e9470cbb178297-1.method: Kettle temperature measured for the first time; the water was hotter than in earlier cups.

5ead8ae5f740c74b-1.note: Thin and watery on entry, lacking bright acidity; sweetness mid-palate with a sweet aftertaste, honey and a little fruit.
5ead8ae5f740c74b-1.correction: The timer started about 135 s before the first pour; time and curve were shifted (5:50 to 3:35).

3587f497a2ce893c-2.note: Fuller body, no longer watery; a bit more acidity, less sweetness, slightly mouth-drying finish.
3587f497a2ce893c-2.method: 1:15; the only change from the day before was hotter water.

b13ecbb25e2810e6-1.method: Aiming for high TDS at low extraction: cooler water and 1:14.

fbf60f434d31b68f-1.method: 1:17; floating grounds pushed under at 0:30, no further stirring.

fbf60f434d31b68f-2.note: More acidic than earlier cups; now a fairly typical Gesha profile.
fbf60f434d31b68f-2.correction: Start was pressed about 10 s and 130 g into the pour; 182.3 g of water was restored from the first curve sample.

e3938197d0d378bb-1.note: Too sour, no sweetness, a hint of mouth-drying.

57469a1fdb0bc4e9-1.note: Very bitter; the grind felt too fine.

57469a1fdb0bc4e9-2.method: One stir at about 1:10; valve opened at 2:00.

57469a1fdb0bc4e9-3.note: Slightly sour on entry, a little mouth-drying, not much sweetness; an unremarkable light roast.

2e2f583573bde15d-2.note: Good; the best of the four cups that morning.

5e3f5122a6b97134-1.note: Complex but still a little mouth-drying; not enjoyable.

857adcdd5da0c749-1.correction: The timer started before the brewer settled; 69 g of non-water load was removed.

9fb096ff36577b98-1.note: A little more mouth-drying than usual, but still fairly good.

9fb096ff36577b98-2.note: A little more mouth-drying than usual, but still fairly good.

56d15792fb96e845-1.method: Forgot to close the valve at the start, so about 10 g ran through before it was closed; valve opened at 2:01.
56d15792fb96e845-1.correction: The first watch reading was 1.55% TDS (an impossible 26.5% extraction); the re-measured 1.25% is used.

96265b3376ec6b86-1.method: Brewed with Crystal Geyser Alpine Spring Water. Comandante C40, 24 clicks.

2fe7ae0bd889e293-1.method: Kettle set to 93 C. No slurry temperature measurement.
2fe7ae0bd889e293-1.correction: Bean identity has not been confirmed; no bean is assigned.

2fe7ae0bd889e293-2.method: Ten-pour pulse method. Comandante C40, 40 clicks. Kettle set to 96 C.
2fe7ae0bd889e293-2.correction: The watch logged V60; the actual brewer was Fellow Stagg [X]. Invalid probe readings were removed from the source trace; weights are unchanged.
